elements.name: small town along the top of a high green ridge
small terraced fields on steep slopes
layers of mountains fading into blue haze

wrong_setting: The houses are rendered stone cottages with orange clay-tile roofs and the trees read as poplars or cypresses, so the village looks like a Mediterranean or southern European hill village rather than an Ethiopian highland town.
notes: Repaint the roofs as rusty corrugated tin on simple low Ethiopian houses, and swap the poplar-like trees for tall, loose-crowned eucalyptus. Move the town up onto the ridge crest instead of the mid-slope, and warm the light toward gold.
